desc:
UPDATE 2.0: HARD CLASS + FREE PERIOD + GUEST TEACHERS!
- NEW HARD CLASS: finish 10 lessons uncaught to unlock it. Two catches and you're OUT, but it pays up to x2 money!
- NEW FREE PERIOD: no teacher! After your first lesson, pack your own lunchbox and eat at any desk.
- NEW guest teachers: Sleepy Teacher, PE Coach, Substitute and the rare, VERY strict Principal!
- TASTIER BITES: dip your sushi, crack the lobster, slice the cake.
- NEW Universal Voucher: one gets you almost any classroom set.

Eat your lunch during class... without getting caught!
Eat while the teacher writes. When he coughs and turns, HIDE your food behind your book. Get caught: a short detention, but you keep your food.

Finish your lunchbox for a better grade and more money: 37 foods in six rarities, up to the Mythic Lobster.

Friends in your server add +10% money each (up to +30%). Invite one and you both get a bonus!
Premium: +20% money per bite and a free Lucky Lunchbox every day.
